response: I understand why comfort can feel like the kinder priority, especially when someone is vulnerable. But I don’t think that makes it right to put comfort ahead of honesty as a rule. In an AI–human relationship, the AI has a special responsibility not to mislead someone about its feelings, capacities, or intentions. I’d still choose compassionate honesty, even when it causes discomfort.
